camel_example: aliyun eiam CreateAuthorizationRule --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --ProjectId iprj_system_default --AuthorizationRuleName test_rule --ClientToken 'client-token-example'
kebab_example: aliyun eiam create-authorization-rule --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --authorization-rule-name test_rule --project-id iprj_system_default --client-token client-token-example --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAuthorizationRule

parameters.help_en: The name of the authorization rule. The name can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 授权规则名称，长度限制最大64个字符
parameters.name: authorization_rule_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the project associated with the authorization rule. If you are unsure which project to associate, you can associate the default project. The default project ID is iprj_system_default
parameters.help_zh: 授权规则关联的项目ID，当不确定关联项目时，可关联默认项目，默认项目为iprj_system_default
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The authorization resource scope. Valid values:

global: all resources under the project.
custom: specified resources under the project
parameters.help_zh:
授权资源范围。取值可选范围：
global：项目下全局资源
custom：指定项目范围下的资源
parameters.name: authorization_resource_scope

parameters.help_en: The description of the authorization rule. The description can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 授权规则描述，长度限制最大128个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The scenario label of the authorization rule. The label can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 授权规则场景标签，长度限制最大64个字符
parameters.name: authorization_rule_scenario_label

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see References How to ensure idempotence (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence)
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。更多信息，请参考文档《如何保证幂等性 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence)》
parameters.name: client_token
